name: Prismveil Genewear Showcase Set
description: A Tier 3 club outfit engineered from the ground up for geneware-modded bodies — specifically those with tails, horns, bioluminescent skin, or non-functional wings. The top is a structured halter in deep indigo holographic-trim fabric, the shimmer shifting between violet and copper depending on angle and light source. The back is entirely open in a dramatic plunge with a tailored split that widens at the base — a generous, finished tail-aperture with smooth synth-satin edging that won't chafe fur or scale tissue. Pants are wide-cut palazzo style in layered sheer iridescent organza over a matte charcoal liner, with a high-rise waist that sits below any spinal modification hardware and a back seam that opens via hidden magnetic closures to accommodate tail roots of any diameter. A lightweight cape attachment — holographic-trim organza in shifting amber-to-teal — clips at the shoulder blades and drapes asymmetrically, designed to rest over non-functional wing stubs without compression. Horn-wearers benefit from a simple crown-accessory option: a brushed-rose-gold circlet that wraps the base of a single horn or bridges between two, embedded with slow-pulse biolum nodes. Shoes are open-toe block-heel sandals in rose-gold synth-leather, adjustable to accommodate digitigrade feet or standard human proportions.
functionality: Full geneware accommodation: finished tail-aperture with magnetic closure expansion, cape designed to rest over wing stubs without restricting circulation, adjustable horn circlet, digitigrade-compatible footwear. Holographic trim is passive — no power required. Biolum nodes in the circlet run on a 48-hour micro-cell.
what_it_says: Middle-management or small business owner who invested in geneware mods and wants clothes that celebrate rather than awkwardly accommodate them. This outfit says the modifications were a choice, not an accident — they're displayed with intention and dressed to match. The holographic trim is aspirational without being pretentious.
worn_by: geneware-modded Tier 3 professionals on nights out
small business owners with cosmetic modifications
mid-tier club regulars with tails, horns, or wing stubs
bioluminescent-skinned patrons who want their glow complemented rather than competed with
manufacturer: Cascara Mods & Thread (Tier 3 boutique, specializes in geneware-compatible fashion)
story_hooks: A club has a strict 'no visible geneware' door policy — nominally illegal under M88 anti-discrimination statutes but quietly enforced — and a wearer in this outfit becomes the test case when they're turned away and decide to push back publicly.

The biolum nodes in the horn circlet begin resonating with another patron's bioluminescent skin modification at close range, creating an unintended light-sync effect that draws a crowd — and the attention of someone who shouldn't be watching.

The manufacturer is accused of stealing geneware-accommodation designs from a Tier 1 self-modified community that pioneered the tail-aperture construction years earlier — the wearer, unknowingly dressed in contested IP, gets caught in the middle.
related_entities: Kessler Kinetics VelocityFrame MkIV Sprint Leg

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking club ensemble that celebrates augmented bodies with unapologetic sensuality. The silhouette is dramatic and asymmetrical—a structured halter top commanding attention above, flowing palazzo pants below, with strategic cutouts and openings that read as intentional design rather than exposure. The holographic shimmer catches light like oil on water, shifting between jewel tones. Worn by someone with visible geneware modifications, this outfit transforms into a second skin that honors their altered form.
physical_description.fit: High-waisted, body-conscious through the torso with dramatic negative space at the back. Palazzo pants sit loose and architectural from hip to ankle, creating a striking contrast with the fitted top. The halter is tailored precision; the back plunge is generous but controlled. Everything is engineered for comfort around hardware—no compression points.
physical_description.primary_material: Holographic-trim synth-fabric (top halter and cape), layered iridescent organza over matte charcoal liner (pants), synth-satin edging (tail aperture), brushed rose-gold synth-leather (shoes). All materials are temperature-regulating and non-reactive to bio-mod tissue.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and fluid holographic shimmer on visible panels, crisp structured halter with subtle ribbed support weave, sheer organza with delicate drape, satin-smooth internal seams and closures, matte charcoal liner providing invisible structure underneath.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep indigo with violet-to-copper holographic shift (top), layered iridescent-to-charcoal (pants), amber-to-teal holographic cape, rose-gold accents (circlet, shoes). Overall palette: cool jewel tones with warm metallic punctuation.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic closures along back seam of pants (silent, secure, easily adjusted). Halter ties at neck and lower back. Cape clips at shoulder blades (quick-release). Circlet is adjustable wrap-around. Shoes feature adjustable straps.
distinctive_features: Tail-aperture with synth-satin edging—engineered to prevent chafing on fur or scales
Entirely open plunge back with widening split at base
Hidden magnetic closures for easy on/off around spine hardware
Asymmetrical holographic cape draped to avoid wing-stub compression
Optional rose-gold circlet with embedded slow-pulse biolum nodes
Open-toe block heels adjustable for digitigrade or standard feet
All internal seams and edges finished to Tier 1 luxury standard despite Tier 3 pricing
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional luxury—expensive and specialized enough to signal investment in geneware modifications, but street-accessible. Not corpo exclusivity; this is working-class pride in augmentation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by club-goers, street performers, body-mod enthusiasts, and anyone who wears their augmentations openly and celebrates them. Signals: 'I am modded and unashamed. I spend Φ on looking extraordinary.' This is geneware subculture—anti-corpo aesthetic that's simultaneously artistic and defiant.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly broken-in. Holographic trim may show micro-scratches from wear, but fabric remains structurally intact. Magnetic closures are durable. This is garment investment—meant to be cared for, worn frequently, possibly customized.

The structured indigo halter hugs defined musculature; the dramatic open back plunge and tail-aperture are the composition's focal point, framed against moody purple-and-teal neon from a club environment.
